tasks.short: Sum the amount in force and decide

steps.what: Review company records for the amount of insurance in force
Sum a single risk or a group of closely related risks
Determine whether that amount of insurance is acceptable

tasks.design: Company records of insurance in force are opened from {DATA_PLATFORM}. The amount is summed for a single risk or a group of closely related risks. A record without an amount stays blank and the total stops. The underwriter determines whether the amount is acceptable. The sum does not decide.
tasks.previous_blocker: The in-force amount was added up from separate records.
tasks.enabler_now: The in-force records are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Accepting the amount stays with the underwriter.
tasks.human_edge: The underwriter knows which risks are closely related.

ambition.what: A summed amount can be checked before the underwriter accepts it.

tasks.altitude: The week still includes the acceptance. The sum is ready before the underwriter reads it.

reach.learn: Which risk ids were in the sum.

evidence.claim: Stored in-force amounts for a risk id can be summed. A record without an amount stays blank. The underwriter still determines whether the total is acceptable. A stored row can show the file id and the value a person already entered. The underwriter still decides. A blank stays blank.
The sum is not a decision to bind. The underwriter determines whether the amount is acceptable. This work does not score a person. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when in-force records are stored for a risk or a group and ends when the underwriter has accepted the amount or returned a blank record.
A record row has record id, risk id, group id, and amount, entered by the policy admin. A blank amount is not filled. The group of closely related risks is one a person assigned.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the underwriter's effort.
A missing amount, rate row, or document id is not invented. The underwriter does that part.
The incremental hour updates the opened file when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often a record in the group has no amount.
research_questions: Which amounts were accepted, and which sums stopped on a blank record?

already_counted.description: Reading the opened file is already in the underwriter's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened file when its source row changes.

approvals.approved_version: The amount in force and the underwriter's acceptance of it

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: a record has no amount and the underwriter adds the file by hand. High: the records are complete and the underwriter still determines whether the amount is acceptable. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Change the value and apply the rating

steps.what: Open policy value and reference materials
Decrease substandard value and specify applicable endorsements
Place stored endorsements for a reference id already chosen
Apply rating using reference materials to ensure profitable distribution of risks

tasks.design: The policy value and the reference materials are opened from {DOCS}. The underwriter decides that the risk is substandard, decreases the value, and specifies the applicable endorsements. Stored endorsement text is placed only for a reference id the underwriter chose. The underwriter applies the rating, using the reference materials, to ensure a profitable distribution of risks, and signs it. The screen does not decide substandard and does not apply a loading on its own.
tasks.previous_blocker: The rating change was a note written against a reference binder.
tasks.enabler_now: The policy, the reference materials, and the rating rows are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The substandard call, the value decrease, and the rating stay with the underwriter.
tasks.human_edge: The underwriter judges the risk and the distribution.

ambition.what: A rating change can be released only after the underwriter signs it.

tasks.altitude: The week still includes the rating. Reference text is open before the underwriter chooses.

reach.learn: Which reference ids and rating row were signed.

evidence.claim: A reference id can place stored endorsement text. The underwriter still decides substandard, decreases the value, and applies the rating. A stored row can show the file id and the value a person already entered. The underwriter still decides. A blank stays blank.

Applying a rating is pricing. The source pack says life and health insurance pricing is high-risk, and that a score which determines the outcome is an automated decision. The underwriter applies the rating. A rating row is not a score of a person's health. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a policy and its reference materials are stored and ends when the underwriter has signed the value decrease and the rating, or stopped.

A reference row has reference id and endorsement text, entered by the underwriting lead. A rating row has rating id and amount, entered by the underwriting lead. The underwriter chooses the ids. A missing id inserts nothing.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the underwriter's effort.
A missing amount, rate row, or document id is not invented. The underwriter does that part.
The incremental hour updates the opened file when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often the reference materials do not cover the risk.
research_questions: Which value decreases and ratings were signed, and which stopped for a missing reference id?

already_counted.description: Reading the opened file is already in the underwriter's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened file when its source row changes.

approvals.approved_version: The value decrease and the endorsement reference ids
The rating row and the distribution note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the reference materials do not cover the risk and the underwriter stops. High: the materials are open and the underwriter still decreases the value and applies the rating. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Authorize reinsurance of a high risk

steps.what: Open the policy and the reinsurance terms
Authorize reinsurance of the policy when the risk is high

tasks.design: The policy and the reinsurance terms are opened from {DOCS}. The underwriter authorizes reinsurance of the policy when the risk is high. The screen does not authorize and does not mark the risk high.
tasks.previous_blocker: The terms were a file the underwriter read before authorizing.
tasks.enabler_now: The policy and the terms are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The authorization stays with the underwriter.
tasks.human_edge: The underwriter judges that the risk is high enough to reinsure.
tasks.altitude: The week still includes the authorization. The terms are open before the underwriter decides.

evidence.claim: A stored policy and its reinsurance terms can be opened. Authorizing reinsurance stays with the underwriter. A stored row can show the file id and the value a person already entered. The underwriter still decides. A blank stays blank.
The authorization is the underwriter's act. The screen does not authorize and does not score the risk. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a policy has reinsurance terms and ends when the underwriter has authorized reinsurance or refused it.
A terms row has terms id, policy id, and text, entered by the reinsurance lead. The row does not contain an authorization.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the underwriter's effort.
A missing amount, rate row, or document id is not invented. The underwriter does that part.
The incremental hour updates the opened file when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often the terms do not match the policy in front of the underwriter.
research_questions: Which policies were authorized for reinsurance, and which the underwriter refused?

already_counted.description: Reading the opened file is already in the underwriter's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened file when its source row changes.

approvals.approved_version: The reinsurance authorization for this policy

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the terms do not match the policy and the underwriter stops. High: the terms are open and the underwriter still authorizes or refuses. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The underwriter still judges the amount in force, changes the rating, and authorizes reinsurance. A stored total is open first.
reach: The file shows a rating change only after the underwriter signs it.
Reinsurance is authorized only by the underwriter.
skills_to_grow: Do not treat a summed amount as acceptable by itself.
Do not mark a risk substandard from a file.
Do not authorize reinsurance from a screen.
role.ambitious_version: In-force amounts and reference text are ready before the decision. The underwriter still accepts the total, changes the rating, and authorizes reinsurance.
